description: This file appears to be a PHP source script responsible for generating a web page related to network and Ethernet LAN configuration in a gateway device. It includes server-side logic for retrieving network status, configuring Ethernet ports, and rendering HTML with embedded JavaScript for user interaction.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines whether Port 4 of the Ethernet LAN is enabled with XHS (Home Security) based on device parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps network statuses to human-readable labels, considering various device and WAN configurations.

methods.name: onsavePort4
methods.description: Handles the user action to save the port 4 XHS enable/disable setting via AJAX.

methods.name: initEvents
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for page elements, such as the save button.
